items.name: Glob
items.summary: Glob represents a successfully parsed shell glob pattern.

methods.name: compile_matcher
methods.summary: Returns a matcher for this pattern.

methods.name: glob
methods.summary: Returns the original glob pattern used to build this pattern.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Builds a new pattern with default options.

methods.name: regex
methods.summary: Returns the regular expression string for this glob.

methods.name: allow_unclosed_class
methods.signature: fn allow_unclosed_class(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut GlobBuilder<'a>
methods.summary: Toggle whether unclosed character classes are allowed. When allowed, a `[` without a matching `]` is treated literally instead of resulting in a parse error.

methods.name: backslash_escape
methods.signature: fn backslash_escape(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut GlobBuilder<'a>
methods.summary: When enabled, a back slash (`\`) may be used to escape special characters in a glob pattern. Additionally, this will prevent `\` from being interpreted as a path separator on all platforms.

methods.name: case_insensitive
methods.signature: fn case_insensitive(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut GlobBuilder<'a>
methods.summary: Toggle whether the pattern matches case insensitively or not.

methods.name: empty_alternates
methods.signature: fn empty_alternates(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut GlobBuilder<'a>
methods.summary: Toggle whether an empty pattern in a list of alternates is accepted.

methods.name: literal_separator
methods.signature: fn literal_separator(&mut self, yes: bool) -> &mut GlobBuilder<'a>
methods.summary: Toggle whether a literal `/` is required to match a path separator.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new builder for the pattern given.

items.name: GlobMatcher
items.summary: A matcher for a single pattern.

methods.name: glob
methods.summary: Returns the `Glob` used to compile this matcher.

methods.name: is_match
methods.signature: fn is_match<P: AsRef<Path>>(&self, path: P) -> bool
methods.summary: Tests whether the given path matches this pattern or not.

methods.name: is_match_candidate
methods.summary: Tests whether the given path matches this pattern or not.
